release_notes: v9.8.26 — CRITICAL fix for Tally Prime 7.0 AlterID detection (RCA done from a real customer's daybook XML export). (1) Tally Prime 7.0 lowercases every response tag — Path-3 regex is now case-insensitive. (2) Voucher collections in Tally Prime 7.0 return EMPTY without SVFROMDATE / SVTODATE — now included with a 2014-2099 wide range. (3) NEW Path-4 side-channel scrapes <alterid> directly from cached voucher / daybook XMLs as a last-resort. (4) Misleading 'AlterID unsupported' log on the first cycle after upgrade is now 'AlterID baseline captured (N). One-time LVD-gated sync this cycle.' so customers immediately understand the agent IS working. Each path prints which one fired so the agent log clearly shows: AlterID via Path-N (...) = N.
